dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgRemoveLiqu.title: Msg Remove Liquidity
dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgRemoveLiqu.description: * Remove liquidity from a pool by burning shares and returning underlying reserves. Behavior: - Supports two modes: full exit and partial exit. - Full exit: when burning all outstanding shares, the pool is deleted and   the full reserves are paid out to the caller. - Partial exit: burns a subset of shares and receives a payout proportional   to that share using pro-rata DecCoins math; pool remains active with   reduced reserves. - Ensures partial exits cannot deplete any reserve below zero; full exit   required to withdraw the last liquidity. Validation: - Pool must exist. - Signer must hold at least shares. - Shares must be a positive integer string. - Partial exits cannot deplete any reserve; withdrawing the last liquidity   requires a full exit (burning all shares). Emits: - EventPoolLiquidityRemoved with pool_id and shares. Returns: - coins returned to the caller in the amount field.

amount.description: Coins returned to the caller proportional to the burned shares.
